model.title: Explain one cause of river flooding. (2 marks)

parts.text: Point: prolonged rainfall saturates the soil (1)
Development: so rain cannot infiltrate and runs off quickly into the river, raising discharge (1)

keywords.def: the instruction word in a question
a point with an explanation or consequence
the description of what an answer at each level shows
fixing a gap in knowledge or skill

questions.q: Upgrade: 'Waves erode the cliff.' to a developed point. (2 marks)
questions.a: Destructive waves throw rocks at the cliff (abrasion) (1), wearing away the base and forming a wave-cut notch (1)

questions.q: Core: Rewrite your two lowest-scoring mock answers in the portal response box using the mark scheme, then complete your repair list.
questions.a: Improved answers with developed points and place detail

questions.q: Extend: Answer: 'Explain two ways hard engineering can reduce coastal erosion.' (4 marks)
questions.a: e.g. sea walls reflect wave energy (2); rock armour absorbs wave energy (2)

questions.q: Stretch: Write the conclusion for an 8-mark answer from your mock with clear criteria.
questions.a: Judgement linked to criteria and evidence

options: Heavy rain saturates soil, so run-off increases and the river floods.
questions.a: B) Heavy rain saturates soil, so run-off increases and the river floods.. It gives a reason and a consequence.
